He founded the Order to guide the broken Ragunna.|[[Carlotta]], [[Veils Off in Sun or Shadow]] }} '''Napoli II''' is a deceased, mentioned only [[NPC]] from [[Rinascita]] history. == Profile== The first time that the [[Dark Tide]] ravaged Rinascita, it was stopped by Napoli II, who went on to restore civilization and establish the [[Order of the Deep]] where he served as its first Primus and guided [[Ragunna]]. However, he died shortly after that. On his death bed, he gave the prophecy of the [[Cartethyia|Blessed Maiden]]. According to Order's current doctrine, Napoli II had received a prophecy from the Sentinel that in a distant future, a "Last Wave" shall engulf the earth. ==Trivia== ===Etymology === *The name Napoli is an Italian word derived from a Greek word that means "new city". ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = The First Primus |1_zhs = 初代主座 |1_zht = 初代主座 |1_ja = 初代{{Rubi|主座|しゅざ}} |1_ko = 초대 수좌 |1_fr = |1_de = |1_es = |2_en = Napoli II |2_zhs = 那不盖勒二世 |2_zht = |2_ja = |2_ko = |2_fr = Napoli II |2_de = Napoli II |2_es = Napoli II }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}}
